`r lectureLine(11)`

Block 2 is all about using categorical predictors to explain variability in a dependent variable, and the most basic way to do that is comparing two groups to each other, and that is called a t-test. Our life is all about comparing means, so life is going to be very mean in block two, and we're going to start off a little slow and look at t-tests from some different angles. We can analyze a single mean and test whether that value is equal to some hypothesized value, or compare 2 means in a between subjects design or a within subjects design. Even the t-test, just to prime you already a little bit, is an instance of the linear model.
